title: WDAC REFERENCE POLICY WORKFLOW
subtitle: APP CONTROL FOR BUSINESS
AUDIT → MERGE → ENFORCE
ONE POLICY GUID
DATE-BASED VERSIONS
PAW STIG V-243450 / V-243451
description: One reference PAW builds its App Control policy in six phases. Phases 1 and 2 prepare the device and deploy an audit-mode baseline. Phases 3 and 4 run every needed application, turn the logged 3076 events into allow rules, sanitize them, merge them into the base policy and screen until no new events appear. Phases 5 and 6 turn Audit Mode off, deploy the enforced policy and verify the two STIG findings V-243450 and V-243451. All stages keep one policy GUID with a rising date-based version, apply live with CiTool, and record their evidence.
